name: Raid - Seofon (Impossible) 4M Honors
description: Seofon (Impossible) / Siete HL 4,000,000 Honors Blue Chest farmer [Ex A Party 3 (Group 15, Priority 153): MC Manadiver + Percival + Zeta + Yuel (Backline: Michael + Alanaan)]. Respects Turn-1 99-turn summon lock (no Turn-1 quick_call), cancels 77,777,777 Emblema, and hits 4,000,000 honors in 2-3 turns.

steps.name: Make sure combat full load & interactable
Reload F5 (Cancel Entry Summon-Lock Animation)
Character 1 Skill 2 (MC Miserable Mist)
Character 1 Skill 3 (MC Secret Triad +30% Charge & Fill Diamonds)
Character 1 Skill 1 (MC Manadiver Aether Siphon Drain Diamond for +40% Charge)
Character 1 Skill 4 (MC Wild Magica Double Strike)
Character 2 Skill 1 (Percival Roter Wirbel + Singed)
Character 2 Skill 2 (Percival Regieren + Grovel/Petrify)
Character 3 Skill 3 (Zeta Arvess Fugue Salted Wound Assassin)
Character 3 Skill 2 (Zeta Roar of a Thousand Flames + Assassin Nuke)
Character 3 Skill 1 (Zeta Furious Resonance + Crimson Will Echo & Dispel)
Character 4 Skill 1 (Yuel Foxflame Familiars + Team DMG Amplify & Singed)
Character 4 Skill 2 (Yuel Crimson Dance: Chin + Stance)
Character 4 Skill 3 (Yuel Third Dance: Shien 3-Hit Flurry Out-of-Turn Attack)
Reload F5 (Cancel Yuel Shien Out-of-Turn Attack Animation)
Wait for Combat Ready after Yuel Shien Reload
Execute Turn 1 Attack (Cancels 77,777,777 Emblema & Triggers Celestial Dominion)
Reload F5 (Post-Turn 1 Animation Cancel)
Wait for Turn 2 Combat Ready
Character 2 Skill 3 (Percival Koenig Dekret Full-Party Out-of-Turn Attack)
Reload F5 (Cancel Koenig Dekret Out-of-Turn Attack Animation & Sync Honors)
Exit Early if 4,000,000 Honors Reached
Wait for Turn 2 Normal Attack Ready
Execute Turn 2 Burst Attack (MC Double Strike + Celestial Dominion)
Reload F5 (Post-Turn 2 Animation Cancel)
Exit Early if 4,000,000 Honors Reached
Wait for Turn 3 Finisher Ready
Character 4 Skill 2 (Yuel Crimson Dance: Yaku + Double Strike & Auto-Nuke)
Execute Turn 3 Attack to Secure 4M Honors
Reload F5 (Post-Turn 3 Animation Cancel)
Exit Early if 4,000,000 Honors Reached
Wait for Turn 4 Finisher Ready
Execute Turn 4 Finisher Attack to Lock 4M Honors
Reload F5 (Post-Turn 4 Animation Cancel)
Confirm Battle Result & Rerun
